spec2def(resutils.dll resutils.spec)

# resutils.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/resutils-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(resutils resutils-cargo resutils.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
